# evroc_security_group (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc security group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the security group to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the security group is located.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the security group was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule` (Set of Object) List of security group rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))
- `sg_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the security group.

<a id="nestedatt--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Read-Only:

- `direction` (String)
- `end_port` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
- `remote_ip` (String)
